meta.title: Oracle vectors: Liljegren et al. (2008) outdoor WBGT (thermofeel 2.3.0 implementation)

units.fdir: fraction of GHI that is direct beam

conventions.averaging: radiation is the mean over (t_end-60min, t_end]; solar geometry evaluated at t_end-30min
conventions.zenith: NOAA apparent (refraction-corrected) zenith, as wbgt.c adds refraction
conventions.fdir: Liljegren: S*=min(GHI/TOA,0.85); GHI_used=S*TOA; fdir=clamp(exp(3-1.34S*-1.65/S*),0,0.9); TOA=1367*cz/R^2, 0 if cz<0.00873
conventions.wind: u10'=max(u10,0.62); urban power law u2=max(u10'*(2/10)^p,0.13); p from Pasquill class (LSRDT)
conventions.nulls: null = not applicable or not converged

lemke_kjellstrom_2012.assumptions: P = 1013.25 hPa; wind is the 2 m wind; solar-dependent points need geometry the paper does not state: fdir = 0.8 and cos(zenith) = 1 assumed (fdir 0.8 = 'propDirect' of the Lemke VBA lineage, see HeatStress R wbgt.Liljegren). The S = 0 point is geometry-free.
lemke_kjellstrom_2012.source: Lemke B, Kjellstrom T. Calculating workplace WBGT from meteorological data: a tool for climate change assessment. Ind Health 2012;50(4):267-278, Figs 1-4 (Liljegren series, filled squares). Digitized from the open-access PDF at 400 dpi (gridline-calibrated, square-template detection); reading uncertainty ~ +/-0.05 degC.
